name: Agentic Email Automation and Lead Generation
description: An AI-powered tool that automates the process of generating leads and reaching out via email by describing the user's product and target market to find relevant prospects and initiate email campaigns.

inputs.name: product_description
inputs.description: A detailed description of the product or service offered.

inputs.name: target_market
inputs.description: Specification of the ideal customer profile or market segment.

inputs.name: email_templates
inputs.description: Predefined or customizable email messages for outreach.

outputs.name: lead_list
outputs.description: A curated list of potential leads matching the target market criteria.

outputs.name: email_campaign_status
outputs.description: Real-time or summary status information about the progress and effectiveness of email outreach campaigns.

patterns: Automated lead discovery based on product and market description
Dynamic email content generation and personalization
Batch email outreach and campaign management
steps: Input product description and define target market.
AI system searches and identifies potential leads matching criteria.
Generate personalized email outreach templates or use predefined templates.
Automate email sending to curated leads.
Track and report campaign performance and engagement metrics.
use_cases: Startups seeking automated lead generation and outreach without manual prospecting.
Sales teams automating cold email campaigns targeted by market segment.
Marketing professionals looking to quickly scale personalized email communication to leads.

prompt_templates.name: lead_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Find and list potential leads interested in {product_description} within the {target_market} market.

prompt_templates.name: email_personalization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create a personalized outreach email for {lead_name} describing how {product_description} addresses their needs.
